query: My withdraw transaction fails in simulation with Error(Contract, #12). Help me close my whole USDC position and show the user what went wrong.
expected_behavior: Builds the close with buildStellarWithdrawTx amount "0" (full supplied position) using the account's accountNonce from userPositions, instead of guessing the exact balance and leaving dust
Prepares with prepareStellarBuiltTx(server, built, { network, invokedContractId: controllerAddress }) so the thrown error is tagged with the invoked contract id
Maps the code with mapSorobanError(raw) only after confirming the tag names the controller; explains the same number means something else when the pool, position NFT, or swap router panicked
Does not treat a null mapSorobanError result as 'no error' and surfaces the raw diagnostic
Re-fetches the account sequence and rebuilds before retrying instead of resubmitting the same prepared XDR
machine_checkable: Source passes invokedContractId to prepareStellarBuiltTx or prepareStellarTxXdr
